executions.name: One More for the Bandolier
executions.script: He takes the head with the saber in one ceremonial arc and holds it up to his lantern-flame to look at it — the flame has no eyes and it is definitely looking. The others greet it.

executions.name: Company
executions.script: He doesn't take their head cleanly — he swaps it. His body walks off wearing their horrified face; his laughing head rides their stumbling body in circles. The Court finds this one hilarious.

desecration.name: Kicked It
desecration.script: The planted Head, kicked one time too many, simply finishes it — the body still crossing the screen at a sprint, hands out: drop it. Drop it.

overdrive.name: THE TOLL ROAD
overdrive.script: The background becomes a midnight crossroads. GALLOWS makes three full passes, the Head calling the strikes like a carnival barker.
